2.  Edit the deployment to set a valid image (assuming the user intended to use a standard Nginx image, I will use `nginx:latest` as a safe default, though a more specific image might be better depending on the actual application).
3.  Verify the status of the pods to ensure the repair was successful.

First, I will inspect the deployment manifest.
